company.name: Innov8 Coworking
company.shortDescription: Innov8 is a Y- Combinator backed company that offers coworking and shared office spaces.
company.description:
Innov8 Coworking is a Y- Combinator backed workspaces and community startup based in India. They provide premium workspaces (managed private offices and coworking spaces).

Innov8 Coworking is the first of its kind Thought space in India. They encourage community engagement of like-minded individuals from any space, whether they are founders, investors, freelancers, creators or just want to work in a highly productive zone.

They currently have centers across India - Delhi, Noida, Gurgaon, Mumbai, Bangalore and Chandigarh.
